svg.title: Cost per 100 toilet paper sheets, Costco East 10 June 2026
svg.desc: Horizontal bars of cents per 100 sheets for Kirkland Signature, Cashmere Premium, and Charmin Ultra Soft from the Costco East list posted 10 June 2026. The lowest bar is green.
svg.text: Sheet counts printed on the 10 Jun 2026 Costco East list. Sheet size was not printed, so this is not per square metre.
Cashmere price is after a $5.50 instant saving that the list said expired 5 Jul 2026.
Kirkland is the lowest of these three. A store-brand pack at another banner can still win. Photograph that tag.
Bar length is proportional to cents per 100 sheets. Charmin at 54.15 cents is the long bar.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Ontario and Atlantic Costco East list, not a Canada-wide average.
